title: Shinonome Akito — A Choice To Be Proud Of〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Choice To Be Proud Of（2★）

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back! I got what you asked for, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Great, thanks.
Take a break if you like now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, in that case... Can I have an orange juice?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Who's working for who here...?
Fine, here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay! Wait, huh...?
Akito, you're here already...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you think you can focus during practice now...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean that I figured out what was bothering me and I've made a decision.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't exactly know what I'm supposed to do, so I can't really guarantee anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I know that I just “gotta keep going” now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And every time I think that, I'm reminded of just how much I want to sing with Kohane by my side. I want to be a partner that she can respect and be proud of.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I'm gonna do whatever I can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is more like your usual self.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, there might be no point in asking this now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was wondering if you and Toya went through what I just did...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's been like two years since you partnered with him, right? How have things been?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How am I supposed to answer that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just tell me how you feel things have gone up to this point...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still think about all the stuff that happened in the events we performed in, good and bad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I've never regretted choosing Toya as my partner. Not once.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Despite everything that's happened, from what happened during events or anything you've done, you've never thought about finding a new partner, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just means you have to keep going and make what you believe a reality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I feel much better now!
Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I might have to ask you again about this since you and Toya have more experience with having a partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. And if you ever feel like running from your problems, I'll be there to set you straight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you say that a little nicer...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An, I know I've been telling you this every time, but it's not safe to throw yourself at me like this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? What's with the bag?
There's a bunch of snacks in it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One of the machines at the game center had some snacks that I know you like as prizes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I had a whole assortment of them on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nevermind. We can eat these after we're done practicing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. Azusawa, Shiraishi, you're both welcome to have some as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's start practicing.
